title: General Knowledge Quiz
description: Test your knowledge across various topics including science, history, geography, and culture.

questions.text: What is the capital of Australia?
questions.explanation: Canberra is the capital city of Australia, located in the Australian Capital Territory.

questions.text: Which planet is known as the 'Red Planet'?
questions.explanation: Mars is called the 'Red Planet' due to iron oxide (rust) on its surface.
The Mona Lisa was painted by Leonardo da Vinci between 1503 and 1519.

questions.text: What is the largest ocean on Earth?
questions.explanation: The Pacific Ocean is the largest ocean, covering about 46% of the world's water surface.

questions.text: In which year did World War II end?
questions.explanation: World War II ended in 1945 with the surrender of Japan in September.

questions.text: What is the chemical symbol for gold?
questions.explanation: Au is the chemical symbol for gold, derived from the Latin word 'aurum'.

questions.text: Which of the following is NOT a mammal?
questions.explanation: Penguins are birds, not mammals. They are flightless birds adapted for aquatic life.

questions.text: What is the smallest country in the world?
questions.explanation: Vatican City is the smallest country in the world with an area of 0.17 square miles.

questions.text: Which element has the atomic number 1?
questions.explanation: Hydrogen has the atomic number 1, making it the lightest and most abundant element.

questions.text: The Great Wall of China was primarily built to protect against invasions from which direction?
questions.explanation: The Great Wall was built to protect against invasions from the north, particularly from Mongol tribes.

questions.text: Mount Everest is located in which mountain range?
questions.explanation: Mount Everest is located in the Himalayas on the border between Nepal and Tibet.

questions.text: True or False: The human brain uses approximately 20% of the body's total energy.
questions.explanation: The human brain uses about 20% of the body's total energy despite being only 2% of body weight.

questions.text: What is the currency of Japan?
questions.explanation: The Japanese Yen is the official currency of Japan.

questions.text: Which of these are programming languages? (Select all that apply)
questions.explanation: Python, JavaScript, and Java are programming languages. HTML and CSS are markup/styling languages.

questions.text: What is the largest mammal in the world?
questions.explanation: The Blue Whale is the largest mammal and the largest animal ever known to have lived on Earth.
